mom_settings.intro:
Group Final Quiz 2 — Instructions

This is a collaborative group test. Work with your assigned group to discuss and solve each problem together. Every student must submit their own answers individually on their own device.

Topics covered (Weeks 6–13):

  • Week 6 — Linear Programming (Graphical) (§3.3, §3.5): Graphical LP corner evaluation; LP formulation (objective, constraints, non-negativity)
  • Week 7 — Simplex Method (§4.1–4.2): 2-variable simplex max; 3-variable simplex max
  • Week 8: Midterm — no new content on this quiz
  • Week 9 — Compound Interest and Annuities (§6.1, §6.3): Compound interest annual vs monthly; sinking fund required deposit
  • Week 10 — Loans and Amortization (§6.4): Loan monthly payment + total interest; remaining balance after N payments
  • Week 11 — Sets and Venn Diagrams (§7.1–7.2): Union vs intersection compare; 2-circle Venn survey counts
  • Week 12 — Counting (§7.3, §7.5): Permutations word problem; combinations selection
  • Week 13 — Probability (§8.4): Conditional probability from a 2-way table — P(A|B) vs P(B|A) asymmetry

Group work rules:

  • Discuss first, submit individually. Talk through each problem as a group before anyone submits.
  • Everyone participates. Make sure every group member understands the reasoning before moving on.
  • Three attempts, no penalty. You get 3 tries with the same version. Use them if your group wants to re-check a problem.
  • Stay with your group. Do not leave the classroom or break off from your group until everyone has submitted.

Your individual submission will be graded, but your score reflects your group's collective effort. Work together and make it count.

planning_notes.selection_priority: Even coverage — 2 questions per content week W6, W7, W9, W10, W11, W12, plus single §8.4 slot for W13 (W8 = midterm). 8 reuse (existing MOM qids) + 5 new drafts (slots 2, 6, 8, 10, 12 — each a fresh scenario distinct from existing repo files on the same topic). Conditional probability slot 13 reuses q14-twoway-conditional (qid 1820863) — strictly §8.4-aligned (P(A|B) vs P(B|A) asymmetry from a 2-way table). Originally planned slot 14 (EV) dropped: EV is not covered in any W6–13 assignment in this course. §8.5 independence also dropped: not assigned in any W6–13 HW. Test ends at 13 questions strictly within taught W6–13 content.
